get_model_submit_baseline: get a SubmitBaselineModel instance by passing ModelArguments with model_name set to submit_baseline
get_model_human: get a HumanModel instance by passing ModelArguments with model_name set to human and a list of commands
get_model_human_thought: get a HumanThoughtModel instance by passing ModelArguments with model_name set to human_thought and commands
get_model_replay: get a ReplayModel instance by passing ModelArguments with model_name set to replay and a replay_path
get_model_litellm: get a LiteLLMModel instance by passing ModelArguments with model_name starting with litellm prefix
